title: A Strong Hold
old_p1: Nahum was a prophet long ago, a man who speaks for Heavenly Father. He spoke to the people of Judah.
Nahum wrote, “The Lord is good, a strong hold in the day of trouble.” A strong hold is a tall tower with thick stone walls.
Long ago, when trouble came, families went inside a strong hold. The thick walls kept them safe until the trouble was over.
old_p2: Nahum said the Lord is like that safe place. He also said, “He knoweth them that trust in him.” Trust means believing He will help you. The Lord knows each person who trusts Him. He knows you!
When you feel worried, the Lord is your safe place. Tonight, wrap your blanket around you like strong walls. You can trust Him.
p1: Nahum told the people of Judah what Heavenly Father said. A big, proud city called Nineveh had made trouble for them.
Nahum wrote, “The Lord is good, a strong hold in the day of trouble.”
Long ago, when trouble came, families hurried into a strong hold. It was a tall tower with thick stone walls. The walls kept them safe until the trouble was over.
p2: Nahum said the Lord is like that safe place. He also said, “He knoweth them that trust in him.” The Lord knows each person who trusts Him to help. He knows you!
When you feel worried, run to the Lord, like running into a hug. Tonight, wrap your blanket around you like strong walls. You can trust Him.
